register.labelZh: GET (VOLUME 4) 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: get to、get across、get up、get in 和 get behind 等表達,可以幫助你描述到達某地、越過某處和移到不同位置。；get ahead、get behind with、get by 和 get up to 可以幫助你談論取得進展、進度落後、在有限條件下應付,以及做到某個階段。；你可以用 GET 表示訊息被理解、大家相聚、某人不斷受到批評,或有人刻意和另一個人建立友好關係。；get yourself together、get above yourself、get hung up 和 get into trouble 可以自然描述常見的情緒、人際和實際困難。
register.summaryEn: Expressions such as get to, get across, get up, get in and get behind help you describe reaching places, crossing spaces and moving to different positions. Get ahead, get behind with, get by and get up to help you talk about success, falling behind, managing with limited resources and reaching a stage in your work. You can use GET to show that a message is understood, people meet, someone is repeatedly criticised, or a person tries to become friendly with somebody. Get yourself together, get above yourself, get hung up and get into trouble describe common emotional, social and practical situations in natural English.

Some forms in this volume can appear in more than one natural sentence position. Learn the complete expression, not one fixed sentence shell.
